of the kīrtana the sound supremely auspicious arose
caturdaśa loka bhari’ brahmāṇḍa bhedila
fourteen worlds filling the universe it pierced

217The supremely auspicious sound of the kīrtana arose; it filled the fourteen worlds and pierced the shell of the universe.

কীর্ত্তন-আরম্ভে প্রেম উথলি’ চলিল ৷
নীলাচলবাসী লোক ধাঞা আইল ॥ ২১৮ ॥

kīrtana-ārambhe prema uthali’ calila
at the start of the kīrtana love surging flowed
nīlācala-vāsī loka dhāñā āila
of Nīlācala the residents running came

218As the kīrtana began, love surged up and overflowed, and the people of Nīlācala came running.

কীর্ত্তন দেখি’ সবার মনে হৈল চমৎকার ৷
কভু নাহি দেখি ঐছে প্রেমের বিকার ॥ ২১৯ ॥

kīrtana dekhi’ sabāra mane haila camatkāra
the kīrtana seeing in everyone’s mind arose wonder
kabhu nāhi dekhi aiche premera vikāra
never not we have seen such of love transformations

219Seeing the kīrtana, everyone was struck with wonder: “Never have we seen such transformations of love!”

তবে প্রভু জগন্নাথের মন্দির বেড়িয়া ৷
প্রদক্ষিণ করি’ বুলেন নর্ত্তন করিয়া ॥ ২২০ ॥

tabe prabhu jagannāthera mandira beḍiyā
then the Lord Jagannātha’s temple going round
pradakṣiṇa kari’ bulena nartana kariyā
circumambulation making moves about dance doing

220Then the Lord went dancing round Jagannātha’s temple in reverent circumambulation.

আগে-পাছে গান করে চারি সম্প্রদায় ৷
আছাড়ের কালে ধরে নিত্যানন্দ রায় ॥ ২২১ ॥

āge-pāche gāna kare cāri sampradāya
in front and behind singing do four groups
āchāḍera kāle dhare nityānanda rāya
at the time of falling catches (Him) Nityānanda Rāya

221The four groups sang in front of Him and behind, and whenever He fell, Nityānanda Rāya caught Him.

অশ্রু, পুলক, কম্প, স্বেদ, গম্ভীর হুঙ্কার ৷
প্রেমের বিকার দেখি’ লোকে চমৎকার ॥ ২২২ ॥

aśru, pulaka, kampa, sveda, gambhīra huṅkāra
tears horripilation trembling sweat deep roars
premera vikāra dekhi’ loke camatkāra
of love the transformations seeing the people amazed

222Tears, hair standing on end, trembling, sweat and deep roars — seeing these transformations of love, the people were amazed.61

পিচ্কারি-ধারা জিনি’ অশ্রু নয়নে ৷
চারিদিকের লোক সব করয়ে সিনানে ॥ ২২৩ ॥

pickāri-dhārā jini’ aśru nayane
a syringe’s jet surpassing tears in His eyes
cāri-dikera loka saba karaye sināne
on the four sides the people all are bathed

223The tears from His eyes shot out more forcefully than water from a syringe, and the people all around were bathed in them.62

‘বেড়ানৃত্য’ মহাপ্রভু করি’ কতক্ষণ ৷
মন্দিরের পাছে রহি’ করয়ে কীর্ত্তন ॥ ২২৪ ॥

‘beḍā-nṛtya’ mahāprabhu kari’ kata-kṣaṇa
“the encircling dance” Mahāprabhu doing for some time
mandirera pāche rahi’ karaye kīrtana
of the temple behind staying He does kīrtana

224For some time Mahāprabhu danced the beḍā-nṛtya, the dance around the temple; then, staying behind it, He went on with the kīrtana.63

চারিদিকে চারি সম্প্রদায় উচ্চৈঃস্বরে গায় ৷
মধ্যে তাণ্ডব-নৃত্য করে গৌররায় ॥ ২২৫ ॥

cāri-dike cāri sampradāya uccaiḥsvare gāya
on four sides four groups loudly sing
madhye tāṇḍava-nṛtya kare gaurarāya
in the middle the tāṇḍava dance does Gaura Rāya

225On all four sides the four groups sang loudly, and in their midst Gaura Rāya danced the vigorous tāṇḍava dance.

বহুক্ষণ নৃত্য করি’ প্রভু স্থির হৈলা ৷
চারি মহান্তেরে তবে নাচিতে আজ্ঞা দিলা ॥ ২২৬ ॥

bahu-kṣaṇa nṛtya kari’ prabhu sthira hailā
for a long time dance having done the Lord still became
cāri mahāntere tabe nācite ājñā dilā
the four great souls then to dance order gave

226After dancing for a long time, the Lord became still, and then He told four great souls to dance.

এক সম্প্রদায়ে নাচে নিত্যানন্দ-রায়ে ৷
অদ্বৈত আচার্য্য নাচে আর সম্প্রদায়ে ॥ ২২৭ ॥

eka sampradāye nāce nityānanda-rāye
in one group dances Nityānanda Rāya
advaita ācārya nāce āra sampradāye
Advaita Ācārya dances in another group

227In one group Nityānanda Rāya danced, and in another Advaita Ācārya danced.

আর সম্প্রদায়ে নাচে পণ্ডিত-বক্রেশ্বর ৷
শ্রীবাস নাচে আর সম্প্রদায়-ভিতর ॥ ২২৮ ॥

āra sampradāye nāce paṇḍita-vakreśvara
in another group dances Vakreśvara Paṇḍita
śrīvāsa nāce āra sampradāya-bhitara
Śrīvāsa dances another group within

228In another group Vakreśvara Paṇḍita danced, and in yet another, Śrīvāsa.

মধ্যে রহি’ মহাপ্রভু করেন দরশন ৷
তাঁহা এক ঐশ্বর্য্য হইল প্রকটন ॥ ২২৯ ॥

madhye rahi’ mahāprabhu karena daraśana
in the middle staying Mahāprabhu is watching
tām̐hā eka aiśvarya haila prakaṭana
there one majesty became manifest

229Mahāprabhu stood in the middle watching them, and there a wonder of His divine majesty appeared.64

চারিদিকে নৃত্যগীত করে যত জন ৷
সবে কহে, — প্রভু করে আমারে দরশন ॥ ২৩০ ॥

cāri-dike nṛtya-gīta kare yata jana
on four sides dancing and singing do all people
sabe kahe, — prabhu kare āmāre daraśana
all say the Lord is at me looking

230All those dancing and singing on the four sides said, “The Lord is looking at me!”

চারি জনের নৃত্য দেখিতে প্রভুর অভিলাষ ৷
সেই অভিলাষে করে ঐশ্বর্য্য প্রকাশ ॥ ২৩১ ॥

cāri janera nṛtya dekhite prabhura abhilāṣa
of the four persons the dancing to see the Lord’s desire
sei abhilāṣe kare aiśvarya prakāśa
by that desire He makes of majesty a display

231The Lord wanted to see the dancing of all four, and that desire led Him to display His majesty.

দর্শনে আবেশ তাঁর দেখি’ মাত্র জানে ৷
কেমনে চৌদিকে দেখে, — ইহা নাহি জানে ॥ ২৩২ ॥

darśane āveśa tām̐ra dekhi’ mātra jāne
in His gaze absorption His seeing only they know
kemane caudike dekhe, — ihā nāhi jāne
how on all four sides He looks this not they know

232Seeing the absorption of His gaze, each knew only that He was looking at him; how He could be looking in all four directions at once, no one knew.

পুলিন-ভোজনে যেন কৃষ্ণ মধ্য-স্থানে ৷
চৌদিকের সখা কহে, — আমারে নেহানে ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

pulina-bhojane yena kṛṣṇa madhya-sthāne
at the picnic on the riverbank as Kṛṣṇa in the middle place
caudikera sakhā kahe, — āmāre nehāne
on all four sides friends say at me He looks

233It was just as when Kṛṣṇa sat in the midst of His friends at the meal on the riverbank, and each of them said, “He is looking at me!”65

নৃত্য করিতে যেই আইসে সন্নিধানে ৷
মহাপ্রভু করে তাঁরে দৃঢ় আলিঙ্গনে ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

nṛtya karite yei āise sannidhāne
dance doing whoever comes near
mahāprabhu kare tām̐re dṛḍha āliṅgane
Mahāprabhu gives him a firm embrace

234Whoever came near Him while dancing, Mahāprabhu embraced him tightly.

মহানৃত্য, মহাপ্রেম, মহাসংকীর্ত্তন ৷
দেখি’ প্রেমাবেশে ভাসে নীলাচল-জন ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

mahā-nṛtya, mahā-prema, mahā-saṅkīrtana
the great dance the great love the great saṅkīrtana
dekhi’ premāveśe bhāse nīlācala-jana
seeing in the rapture of love float the people of Nīlācala

235Seeing the great dancing, the great love and the great saṅkīrtana, the people of Nīlācala were swept away in the rapture of love.

গজপতি রাজা শুনি’ কীর্ত্তন-মহত্ত্ব ৷
অট্টালিকা চড়ি’ দেখে স্বগণ-সহিত ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

gajapati rājā śuni’ kīrtana-mahattva
Gajapati the king hearing the glory of the kīrtana
aṭṭālikā caḍi’ dekhe svagaṇa-sahita
the palace climbing watches with his own people

236When the Gajapati king heard of the glory of the kīrtana, he climbed onto the roof of his palace and watched with his attendants.

কীর্ত্তন দেখিয়া রাজার হৈল চমৎকার ৷
প্রভুকে মিলিতে উৎকণ্ঠা বাড়িল অপার ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

kīrtana dekhiyā rājāra haila camatkāra
the kīrtana seeing in the king arose wonder
prabhuke milite utkaṇṭhā bāḍila apāra
the Lord to meet eagerness grew boundless

237Seeing the kīrtana, the king was struck with wonder, and his eagerness to meet the Lord grew boundless.

কীর্ত্তন-সমাপ্ত্যে প্রভু দেখি’ পুষ্পাঞ্জলি ৷
সর্ব্ব বৈষ্ণব লঞা প্রভু আইলা বাসা চলি’ ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

kīrtana-samāptye prabhu dekhi’ puṣpāñjali
at the end of the kīrtana the Lord seeing the flower offering
sarva vaiṣṇava lañā prabhu āilā vāsā cali’
all Vaiṣṇavas taking the Lord came to His lodging going

238When the kīrtana was over, the Lord watched the offering of flowers to Jagannātha and then returned to His lodging with all the Vaiṣṇavas.

পড়িছা আনিয়া দিল প্রসাদ বিস্তর ৷
সবারে বাঁটিয়া তাহা দিলেন ঈশ্বর ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

paḍichā āniyā dila prasāda vistara
the paḍichā bringing gave prasāda in abundance
sabāre bām̐ṭiyā tāhā dilena īśvara
to all distributing it gave the Lord

239The paḍichā brought prasāda in abundance, and the Lord shared it out among everyone.

সবারে বিদায় দিল করিতে শয়ন ৷
এইমত লীলা করে শচীর নন্দন ॥ ২৪০ ॥

sabāre vidāya dila karite śayana
to all leave He gave to go to sleep
ei-mata līlā kare śacīra nandana
in this way pastimes performs of Śacī the son

240Then He let everyone go to take their rest. Such are the pastimes of the son of Śacī.

যাবৎ আছিলা সবে মহাপ্রভু-সঙ্গে ৷
প্রতিদিন এইমত করে কীর্ত্তন-রঙ্গে ॥ ২৪১ ॥

yāvat āchilā sabe mahāprabhu-saṅge
as long as stayed all with Mahāprabhu
prati-dina ei-mata kare kīrtana-raṅge
every day in this way they do in the joy of kīrtana

241For as long as they all stayed with Mahāprabhu, they spent every day like this in the joy of kīrtana.

এই ত’ কহিলুঁ প্রভুর কীর্ত্তন-বিলাস ৷
যেবা ইহা শুনে, হয় চৈতন্যের দাস ॥ ২৪২ ॥

ei ta’ kahilum̐ prabhura kīrtana-vilāsa
this indeed I have told of the Lord the kīrtana pastimes
yebā ihā śune, haya caitanyera dāsa
whoever this hears becomes Caitanya’s servant

242Thus I have described the Lord’s pastimes of kīrtana. Whoever hears of them becomes a servant of Caitanya.

শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ৷
চৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ২৪৩ ॥

śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
Śrī Rūpa’s, Raghunātha’s at the feet whose hope
caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
“Caitanya-caritāmṛta” narrates Kṛṣṇadāsa

243Praying at the feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate the Caitanya-caritāmṛta.

✦

Notes

  1. Heading in the edition: “The dancing Gaura plunges the world into a flood of prema.”
  2. The same verse as Ādi 4.2; translation as there.
  3. Anubhāṣya: what is forbidden is to look upon worldly people and women with the eyes of an enjoyer, as objects of enjoyment.
  4. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: in the same way, the mere sight of a king, even if he is the best of devotees, may give rise to an anartha in one who is renounced.
  5. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: “Gajapati” (“lord of elephants”) was the title of the emperors of Orissa, as other kings bore the titles “chatrapati”, “narapati” or “aśvapati”.
  6. The edition reads «tomāra ājñāya» (“by Your order”); the older text has «icchāya» (“by Your wish”). Anubhāṣya: see Madhya 8.297–298; following Mahāprabhu’s wish, the king publicly released Rāmānanda from worldly affairs — he gave him leave from his post.
  7. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Rāmānanda had drawn this salary as governor of southern Kaliṅga; though released from service, he would go on receiving it.
  8. Heading in the edition: “The devotee of the devotee is the true devotee of Bhagavān” (Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta, 2.6; the words of the Ādi-purāṇa).
  9. Anubhāṣya: the words of Bhagavān to Uddhava on bhakti-yoga.
  10. Heading in the edition: “The worship of the Vaiṣṇava is higher than the worship of Viṣṇu, the Lord of all lords” (Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta, 2.4; the words of Śiva to Pārvatī in the Padma-purāṇa). Anubhāṣya: “those who belong to Him” are Kṛṣṇa’s associates in every rasa — in mādhurya Śrī Rūpa, Vārṣabhānavī and others, in vātsalya Nanda and Yaśodā, in sakhya Śrīdāmā and Subala, in dāsya Citraka and others.
  11. Anubhāṣya: the words of Vidura to Maitreya. Only by serving great souls does one hear hari-kathā; from it love for Hari is born, and with it even concern for the body falls away.
  12. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Purī is Paramānanda Purī, Bhāratī is Brahmānanda Bhāratī, Svarūpa is Svarūpa Dāmodara, Nityānanda is Nityānanda Prabhu — the four Gosāñis of the next verse.
  13. Anubhāṣya: the soul is like the rider in a chariot, the feet are the chariot, and the mind is the charioteer; wherever the mind drives, there the soul goes. Compare Kaṭha Upaniṣad 1.3.3–6, 9: the self is the rider, the body the chariot, the intelligence the charioteer and the mind the reins.
  14. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: having seen Jagannātha, go straight home and meet your relatives.
  15. The words of Pratāparudra to Sārvabhauma; the reference follows the heading in the edition (act 8, verse 29).
  16. Heading in the edition: “The king resolves to give up his life if he does not receive the Lord’s mercy.”
  17. Anubhāṣya: the flower garden is at Guṇḍicā.
  18. Anubhāṣya: after the Snāna-yātrā the painting of Śrī Jagannātha’s body (aṅga-rāga) is renewed, and for that time the Deity stays apart, hidden from those who come for darśana; this period is called anavasara.
  19. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: during the anavasara the Lord could not see Jagannātha and, beside Himself in separation from Kṛṣṇa, went to Ālālanātha and stayed there.
  20. Anubhāṣya: on Gopīnātha Ācārya see Ādi 10.130.
  21. Anubhāṣya: the mahā-bhāgavatas are niṣkiñcanas above varṇāśrama, paramahaṁsas whose only shelter is Kṛṣṇa; as Śrī Narottama Ṭhākura writes in his Prārthanā, “One who regards the associates of Gaurāṅga as eternally perfect goes to the son of the king of Vraja.”
  22. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Narendra is the pond where the Candana-yātrā festival is held; even today Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇavas coming to Puruṣottama wash their hands and feet in its water before going to the temple.
  23. The paḍichā is the superintendent of the temple (see verse 119).
  24. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: “the Ācārya said” — Gopīnātha Ācārya said.
  25. Anubhāṣya: Vidyānidhi Ācārya (Ācāryanidhi) is Puṇḍarīka Vidyānidhi; see the Anubhāṣya on Ādi 10.14.
  26. The heading in the edition gives Ācāryaratna’s name — Candraśekhara.
  27. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Govinda Ghoṣa was born in a Kāyastha family of Uttara-rāḍha; he is called Ghoṣa Ṭhākura, and to this day a fair is held in his name at Agradvīpa, near Katwa. Vāsu Ghoṣa composed many songs about Mahāprabhu, which hold the first place among the songs of the mahājanas.
  28. Heading in the edition: “Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is the founder of saṅkīrtana.”
  29. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: one who worships Kṛṣṇa Caitanya with the sacrifice of saṅkīrtana is truly intelligent; those who do not are kali-hata — Kali has destroyed their intelligence.
